register: Cinematic film still in the Christopher Nolan register: IMAX 70mm feel, deep blacks, practical tungsten and sodium light, restrained palette of paper-cream, brass-amber and ink-blue, heavy atmosphere, photorealistic, no on-screen text, no captions, no watermark, no people's faces in sharp close-up.

files.brief: Overcast winter morning auction in Kew; falling clipboard and lifting pages from knee height.
Worn leather ledger under tungsten light; one entry underlined twice in glistening biro.
Boarded Fitzroy terrace at dawn; iron lacework, tram reflection, weathered illegible A-frame.
Silhouetted rival in a glass boardroom placing one brass building into a backlit city model.
Aerial miniature city at night; warm amber and cold blue fronts meet along one contested street.
